senses.gloss: Garb,Ⓒs.ⒹveSaH-zaH, vastraM, vasanaM, vAsas n., pariDAnaM, prasADanaM; ‘putting on the g(arb) of virtue’ DarmakaMcukapraveSinaH (S. 5).
Garble,Ⓒv. t.ⒹsAcIkf 8 U; satyaM guh 1 U, vikf, vakrIkf.

Garden,Ⓒs.ⒹudyAnaM, upavanaM; ‘g(arden) near a house’ gfhArAmaH, nizkuwaH, gfhavAwikA; ‘pleasure-g(arden)’ krIqopavanaM, ArAmaH, pramadavanaM, AkrIqaH; ‘flower-g(arden)’ puzpavanaM-vAwaH-vAwikA, kusumAkaraH; ‘fruit-g(arden)’ PalavfkzavAwikA; ‘vegetable g(arden)’ SAkavAwikA, SAkaSAkawaM, SAkaSAkinaM; ‘g(arden)-wall’ udyAna-parisaraH-prAkAraH.
Ⓝ[Garden]er,Ⓒs.ⒹudyAnapAlakaH-rakzakaH, mAlAkAraH, mAlikaH, mAlin m.
Ⓝ[Garden]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹudyAnakarman n., udyAnasevanaM-karzaRaM, Palotpattikarman n.

Gargle,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓ(jalaM) Acam 1 P, upa-spfS 6 P, jalena muKaM mfj 2 P or DAv 1 P.
Ⓔs.ⒹAcamanIyaM, AcAmyaM.

Garland,Ⓒs.ⒹmAlA, sraj f., mAlyaM, ApIqaH; SeKaraH, hAraH; ‘g(arland) worn in the hair’ garBakaH; ‘g(arland) hanging from the crest’ praBrazwakaM, SiKAlaMbi mAlyaM; ‘g(arland) worn straight’ prAlaMbaH-bikA; ‘g(arland) worn sideways’ vEkakzikaM; ‘g(arland) of pearls’ hAraH, muktAvalI, mOktikasaraH.
Garlic,Ⓒs.Ⓓla(ra)SunaM, rasonaH-nakaH, mahOzaDaM-gfMjanaM, arizwaH, mahAkaMdaH, sonahaH.

Garment,Ⓒs.ⒹvastraM, vAsas n., vasanaM, pawaH, pariDAnaM, paricCadaH, aMbaraM, pracCAdanaM; veSaH-zaH, ‘under or lower g(arment)’ aMtarIyaM, aDoMSukaM, upasaMvyAnaM, pariDAnaM, aDovAsas n. vasanaM; ‘upper g(arment)’ uttarIyaM, prAvA(va)raH, uttarAsaMgaH, bfhatikA, saMvyAnaM; ‘g(arment) as a protection from wind and cold’ nISAraH.

Garner,Ⓒs.ⒹkuSU(sU)laH, DAnyAgAraM, DAnya, kozWaH, kaMqolaH-lakaH; piwaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹkaMqole niviS c. or ni-DA 3 U.

Garnish,Ⓒv. t.ⒹBUz 10, maMq 10, alaMkf 8 U, parizkf, SuB c.
Ⓝ[Garnish]ment, Garniture,Ⓒs.ⒹprasADanaM, BUzaRaM, alaMkAraH, maMqanaM, ABaraRaM; upakaraRAni (pl.), sajjA.

Garrison,Ⓒs.ⒹdurgarakzakAH (pl.); durgasEnyaM-balaM, rakziRaH-rakzakAH (pl.); rakzivargaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹrakzA; puruzEH yuj 10, (durge) rakziRaH niviS c. or- sTA c. (sTApayati).

Garrulous,Ⓒa.Ⓓativaktf, vAvadUka; bahuBAzin-vAdin, vAcAla, vAjAwa, jalpAka, muKara.
Ⓝ[Garrulous]ness, Garrulity,Ⓒs.ⒹvAcAlatA, vAvadUkatA, ativAdaH, bahuBAzitvaM, atijalpanaM.
Garuda,Ⓒs.ⒹgaruqaH, garutmat m., tArkzyaH, vEnateyaH, KageSvaraH, nAgAMtakaH, vizRuraTaH, suparRaH, pannagASanaH, BujagadAraRaH, BujagaripuH.
